name: VIGIL
tagline: A dignity-first check-in, redesigned to feel steady.
description: Screen redesign of the existing navy VIGIL PWA — a check-in app for survivors of atrocities, and a trend dashboard for the counselors who support them. This is a redesign, not a rebrand: every decision serves one feeling. Steady. Calm and clinical-adjacent, never clinical-cold, playful, or alarming.

components.name: Cover
components.description: The design system's own title card: wordmark, tagline, and the five-swatch palette that carries the whole feeling.

components.name: IconCircle
components.description: The one icon motif used everywhere: an icon inside a soft tinted circle. All tones and sizes, with the full starter icon set.

components.name: Motion
components.description: Reference surface for easings, durations, and the key choreographed sequences — submit, alert stagger, trend draw-in, sync breathing ring — plus a live prefers-reduced-motion toggle.

components.name: SyncStatus
components.description: The small header pill reporting where a check-in's data is: saved on this device, syncing quietly, or synced.

components.name: CheckIn
components.description: The home screen and the four-question skippable check-in flow, with the always-visible crisis entry and the 'saved on this device' confirmation.

components.name: Explainer
components.description: The five-step first-run walkthrough that sets expectations about privacy and control before anyone is asked to check in.

components.name: CounselorDashboard
components.description: The counselor-facing alert queue and per-person trend view: plain-English reasons, never scores, with acknowledge/undo and a baseline-band trend chart.
